$comment: The rayfin-local release Fabricator bundles as a sidecar (scripts/rayfin-local/fetch.mjs), and the Rayfin SDK versions it runs (sdk.supported, sdk.tested and sdk.testedVersions, as its `version --json` says). New projects get the newest Rayfin version within sdk.newProjects, one of those lines, unless New project picks an older one; a line's release in sdk.testedVersions (sdk.tested for sdk.newProjects) when npm can't be reached. Apps can update to the others.
